episodes.synopsis: Liam is an office worker in another world and does not know how he got there. In this new realm, he takes over the body of Liam, the fifth son of a noble family that's about to lose its status, although that doesn't concern him. In this world, magic exists, and he can learn to wield it.
episodes.title: Liam Tries Using Magic for the First Time

episodes.synopsis: Albrevit seems worried about the idea of Liam wanting to succeed his father, so he decides to introduce him to the Hunters' Association, where the young magic enthusiast will soon earn recognition.
episodes.title: Liam Tries Becoming an Adventurer

episodes.synopsis: The eldest of the Hamilton brothers is beside himself over Liam's progress. He tries to accomplish great feats himself, but in the process, he makes a grave mistake.
episodes.title: Liam Tries Talking to a Dragon Fiend

episodes.synopsis: Radon asks Liam to protect some fairies from a forest, as their wings are highly coveted. As part of the process, his magic continues to evolve.
episodes.title: Liam Tries Taking an Elf Familiar

episodes.synopsis: Laim and the elves continue building their village in the Promised Land, which attracts the attention of monsters and humans alike.
episodes.title: Liam Tries Getting Engaged to the Princess

episodes.synopsis: Liam continues to build his nation's strength by recruiting a group of trolls and learning to recreate Radon's magic battle armor.
episodes.title: Liam Tries Making Incredible Armor

episodes.synopsis: Liam's village is threatened by a massive horde of vampires led by a Dracula.
episodes.title: Liam Tries Fighting Dracula

episodes.synopsis: Those under the Dracula's rule have been saved. Liam is now king, recognized by both the people and the surrounding countries.
episodes.title: Liam Tries Becoming King of the Promised Land

episodes.synopsis: Lady Flora's visit is interrupted by an exploding monster.
episodes.title: Liam Tries Talking to a Girl

episodes.synopsis: Liam finds a way for his citizens to procure their own water and salt.
episodes.title: Liam Tries Creating and Playing in an Ocean

episodes.synopsis: Liam stays in his kingdom while Jamil watches him to ensure he doesn't interfere with the drought, so Jamil gets an idea.
episodes.title: Liam Tries Building a Magic City

episodes.synopsis: The dragon knights of Quistador request an audience with Liam.
episodes.title: The Kingdom of Liam Radon
